@@ output/template/.claude/rules/api.md ;; Path rule; loads with backend/**/*.cs and backend/**/launchSettings.json.
@scope path rule: backend/**/*.cs, backend/**/launchSettings.json
1-5 IM ;; Frontmatter paths (loading route).
7 NN ;; Banner.
9 NN ;; Heading.
11-12 NN ;; Pointers.
14 NN ;; Heading.
16-18 OL [api001.http-in-api]
19-22 MX [api003.success-statuses,x.201-location] ;; Status choice is API-003; 'with Location when a stable resource URI exists' is additional.
23-24 OL [api004.empty-collection]
25-27 OL [api005.401-403]
28-29 OL [api006.409-412]
31 NN ;; Heading.
33-35 MX [api013.versioning-need,x.reserved-versioning] ;; API-013 plus the Reserved approval gate for adoption.
36-38 OL [api014.breaking]
39-41 OL [api015.strategy]
42-43 NN ;; Pointer to architecture-decision deprecation section.
45 NN ;; Heading.
47-49 OL [api016.swagger-truth]
50-51 OL [api017.swagger-env]
53 NN ;; Heading.
55-56 OL [api018.health-cheap]
57-60 OL [api019.liveness-readiness]
61-62 OL [api020.health-public]

C api001.http-in-api OL API-001 MUST ;; HTTP status codes/transport semantics belong to the API layer; Application and Domain must not return IActionResult or status codes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.success-statuses OL API-003 MUST ;; Choose 200/201/202/204 by actual HTTP semantics; no blanket 200, no 201 for internal inserts, no 202 for completed work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.201-location EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; A 201 response includes Location when a stable resource URI exists. ;; = ;; Stable resource URI exists. ;; Location header requirement not in the oracle.
C api004.empty-collection OL API-004 DEFAULT ;; By default a successful collection query with zero matches returns 200 with an empty collection, not 404. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api005.401-403 OL API-005 MUST ;; 401 for missing/failed authentication, 403 for authenticated but not permitted; 404 hiding requires a deliberate consistent policy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.409-412 OL API-006 MUST ;; 409 for valid requests conflicting with current state; 412 when an explicit precondition such as If-Match fails. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api013.versioning-need OL API-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce API versioning merely because an API exists; add it for published compatibility or coexisting client generations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.breaking OL API-014 MUST ;; Once relied on by external clients avoid silent breaking changes; a breaking change requires a new version or explicitly approved compatibility strategy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api015.strategy OL API-015 DEFAULT ;; Use one versioning strategy consistently; URL-segment is default unless requirements justify another. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.swagger-truth OL API-016 MUST ;; Swagger/OpenAPI metadata describes the API that actually runs (routes, important statuses, schemas, authentication); no speculative responses. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api017.swagger-env OL API-017 DEFAULT ;; Enable Swagger UI in Development by default; expose elsewhere only when deployment requirements explicitly justify it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api018.health-cheap OL API-018 MUST ;; Health checks remain cheap and deterministic; no full business workflows or expensive/mutating database work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api019.liveness-readiness OL API-019 MUST ;; Liveness must not depend on external dependencies whose unavailability could cause restart loops; readiness may depend on required capabilities and must reflect startup and dependency availability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api020.health-public OL API-020 MUST_NOT ;; No secrets, credentials, connection details, stack traces or unnecessary diagnostics in publicly reachable health responses. ;; = ;; none ;;

C arc001.inward OL ARC-001 MUST ;; Dependencies point inward: Domain none; Application→Domain; Infrastructure→Application, Domain; Api→Application and Infrastructure only for composition/registration; inner layers never depend on outer; no Infrastructure-specific types in Domain/Application. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc003.simple-default OL ARC-003 DEFAULT ;; Domain holds business concepts independent of infrastructure/transport; simple entities are default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc002.domain-independent OL ARC-002 MUST ;; Keep Domain independent of persistence technology, ASP.NET Core, HTTP, persistence and external-service concerns. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc003.crud-in-app OL ARC-003 DEFAULT ;; For CRUD/straightforward workflows keep entities simple and enforce rules in Application Services; validation, immutable fields, transitions or edit rules alone do not justify a Rich Domain Model. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc004.rich-domain-approval OL ARC-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Move behaviour into Domain only for non-trivial invariants benefiting from encapsulation; otherwise Rich Domain/DDD tactical patterns need explicit approval. ;; = ;; Unless the approved specification requires it. ;;
C arc005.no-decorative-ddd OL ARC-005 MUST_NOT ;; No factory methods, private setters, transition methods, Aggregate Roots, Domain Events, Specifications, Domain Services, systematic Value Objects or similar merely to appear domain-driven. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc006.appsvc OL ARC-006 DEFAULT ;; Application Services are the default orchestration mechanism (coordinating Domain, repositories, external abstractions, UoW). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc007.app-abstractions OL ARC-007 MUST ;; Define persistence/external-service abstractions in Application when use cases need them; keep infrastructure details out. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc008.no-tech-in-app OL ARC-008 MUST_NOT ;; Application must not depend on persistence-technology types or ASP.NET Core transport types. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc006.no-pattern-for-size OL ARC-006,ARC-009 DEFAULT ;; An oversized service is a signal to reconsider responsibilities, not an automatic reason to introduce another pattern. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc010.thin-controllers OL ARC-010 MUST ;; Controllers are the default HTTP entry point and stay thin (bind/validate, invoke Application services, translate outcomes). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc011.controller-limits OL ARC-011 MUST_NOT ;; Controllers must not contain business logic, access the persistence session or concrete repositories, or construct infrastructure services manually. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc012.composition-root OL ARC-012 DEFAULT ;; By default Program.cs is the composition root and may register Infrastructure implementations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.controllers-no-infra OL ARC-001,ARC-011 MUST_NOT ;; Controllers do not consume Infrastructure implementation types directly. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc013.specific-repos OL ARC-013 PREFER ;; Prefer specific repository interfaces for cohesive use-case persistence needs over table-mirroring generic CRUD contracts. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc007.repos-in-app OL ARC-007,ARC-014 MUST ;; Define repository interfaces in Application and implement them in Infrastructure; query construction stays in Infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc014.no-iqueryable OL ARC-014 MUST_NOT ;; Repository interfaces must not expose IQueryable<T>, persistence-technology types/query expressions or provider types; return materialized results. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc015.generic-repo OL ARC-015,ARC-019 MUST_NOT ;; Application must not depend on IGenericRepository<T>/generic CRUD contracts; a generic base exists only in Infrastructure to remove genuine duplication and must not replace the technology's query capabilities. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc016.uow-default OL ARC-016 DEFAULT ;; IUnitOfWork is the default commit boundary; repositories stage and do not commit; Application Services decide when to commit. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc016.uow-impl OL ARC-016,ARC-017 MUST ;; Infrastructure implements IUnitOfWork over the scoped persistence session. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc017.shared-session OL ARC-017 MUST ;; Repositories in one use case share the same scoped Unit of Work and persistence session; inject repositories explicitly. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc017.not-container OL ARC-017 MUST_NOT ;; IUnitOfWork must not act as a repository container or service locator. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc024.cache OL ARC-024 MUST ;; Keep cache technology out of Domain; no infrastructure cache APIs in Application without a deliberate boundary abstraction. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc025.http OL ARC-025 MUST ;; Infrastructure translates remote HTTP responses into Application-facing abstractions; no HttpResponseMessage/transport concerns in Application. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.registration OL ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; By default registration stays near the owning layer; Api remains the composition root. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc026.versioned-models OL ARC-026 MUST_NOT ;; No separate Domain/persistence models merely for multiple API versions; version-specific contracts at the API boundary. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc029.dto-dup OL ARC-029 MUST_NOT ;; Do not duplicate equivalent DTOs across Api and Application merely for layer-shaped types; transport contracts when separation gives a concrete benefit. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc028.narrow-test-refs OL ARC-028 MUST_NOT ;; Backend test projects get no broader production references than needed and keep inward discipline. ;; = ;; none ;;

C run009.conventions OL RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Follow existing conventions and .editorconfig; prefer modern C# when clearer; no rewrites solely for newer syntax; consistency over feature maximization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run024.file-scoped-rule OL RUN-024 PREFER ;; For new code prefer file-scoped namespaces when consistent with the project. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run024.one-type OL RUN-024 DEFAULT ;; By default one primary top-level type per file with matching file name. ;; = ;; Small private/nested supporting types may stay with the owner. ;;
C run011.no-reorder OL RUN-011 MUST_NOT ;; Do not reorganize an existing file merely to satisfy a preferred member ordering. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run024.async-suffix OL RUN-024,RUN-011 DEFAULT ;; Task/ValueTask methods use the Async suffix by default; do not rename framework implementations or established APIs when that breaks a contract. ;; = ;; Existing/framework contracts. ;;
C x.cs-constructors EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Primary constructors when DI/simple initialization stays clear; regular constructors when validation/initialization is non-trivial, explicit fields help, the codebase uses that style, or capture hurts understanding. ;; = ;; none ;; Constructor style criteria outside the oracle (EXC-002/EXC-003).
C run009.no-mechanical OL RUN-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not convert constructors mechanically. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cs-records EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Records when value semantics/immutability are desirable (many DTOs, genuine Value Objects); classes for identity/mutable lifecycle/inheritance/framework behaviour; not every DTO/Domain type becomes a record. ;; = ;; none ;; Record/class style rule outside the oracle.
C x.cs-visibility EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Keep implementation details non-public unless public API; use sealed for deliberate non-inheritance intent, not speculative JIT optimization. ;; = ;; none ;; Visibility/sealed conventions outside the oracle.
C run009.modern-when-clearer OL RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Use modern features (collection expressions, pattern matching, switch expressions, target-typed new) when they read better; not when less obvious. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cs-var EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Use var when the type is obvious or unimportant; explicit type when clearer. ;; = ;; none ;; Type-inference convention outside the oracle.
C x.cs-naming EX RUN-009 MUST ;; Standard .NET naming: PascalCase types/methods/properties/public members, camelCase parameters/locals, meaningful names; private fields per repository convention. ;; = ;; none ;; Naming convention not in the oracle.
C run011.no-style-rewrites OL RUN-011 MUST_NOT ;; No style-only rewrites outside the requested change unless explicitly asked. ;; = ;; Explicit request. ;;
C x.cs-no-mixing EX RUN-011 AVOID ;; Avoid mixing large formatting or modernization changes with functional work. ;; = ;; none ;; Goes beyond RUN-011's outside-scope prohibition.

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/composition.md ;; Path rule; loads with backend/**/*.cs and backend/**/appsettings*.json.
@scope path rule: backend/**/*.cs, backend/**/appsettings*.json
1-5 IM ;; Frontmatter paths.
7 NN ;; Banner.
9 NN ;; Heading.
11-13 NN ;; Pointers.
15 NN ;; Heading.
17-18 OL [arc021.ctor-injection]
19-21 OL [arc022.lifetimes]
23 NN ;; Heading.
25-29 OL [run022.typed-options]
30-31 OL [run022.startup-validation]
33 NN ;; Heading.
35-36 OL [run013.structured-logging]
37-40 OL [dep021.addserilog]

C arc021.ctor-injection OL ARC-021 DEFAULT ;; Constructor injection is the default for required dependencies; avoid service-locator and property injection. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.lifetimes OL ARC-022 MUST ;; Never capture a shorter-lived dependency in a longer-lived service; singletons/hosted services needing scoped work create a scope per operation and resolve a scoped orchestration service. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run022.typed-options OL RUN-022 PREFER ;; Prefer strongly typed options for structured configuration; avoid scattered string IConfiguration lookups in services; direct IConfiguration belongs to composition/provider setup/infrastructure registration. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run022.startup-validation OL RUN-022 DEFAULT ;; Validate settings at startup when missing/invalid values prevent correct or secure operation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run013.structured-logging OL RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Use ILogger<T> with structured templates and stable property names; avoid interpolation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep021.addserilog OL DEP-021,DEP-010 DEFAULT ;; When Serilog is configured use DI-integrated AddSerilog() with environment-aware provider configuration; application code depends on ILogger<T>, not Serilog APIs. ;; = ;; none ;;

26-29 MX [dep006.cpm,x.versionoverride-documented] ;; CPM and versionless references are DEP-006; a documented reason for VersionOverride is additional.

47 NN ;; Heading.
49-53 OL [dep007.npm]

C dep.route-add-dependency OL DEP-003,DEP-004,DEP-005 MUST ;; Adding, updating or removing a NuGet/npm dependency follows the add-dependency workflow (version, deprecation, vulnerability, license checks). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep001.need OL DEP-001 MUST ;; Add a dependency only for a concrete current requirement; no hypothetical future use. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep006.cpm OL DEP-006 MUST ;; Use NuGet CPM: versions in Directory.Packages.props, versionless PackageReference by default, no duplicated versions in .csproj. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep006.narrow OL DEP-006 MUST ;; Keep package references in the narrowest project that requires them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep007.npm OL DEP-007 MUST ;; npm by default unless deliberately changed; maintain and commit package.json and package-lock.json; tooling in devDependencies unless there is a reason. ;; = ;; Deliberate other package manager; reason for runtime tooling. ;;
